migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_migrations (
        migration_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        version TEXT NOT NULL,
        checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
        applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS domain_events (
        cursor INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        type TEXT NOT NULL,
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        aggregate_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        aggregate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        aggregate_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS domain_events_type_cursor
        ON domain_events(type, cursor);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_consumer_checkpoints (
        consumer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_records (
        scope TEXT NOT NULL,
        idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        response_status INTEGER NOT NULL,
        response_headers_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        response_body BLOB,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (scope, idempotency_key)
      );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_consumer_failures (
        consumer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        cursor INTEGER NOT NULL,
        event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        attempts INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        last_error TEXT NOT NULL,
        first_failed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        last_failed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (consumer_id, cursor)
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS event_consumer_failures_status
        ON event_consumer_failures(status, last_failed_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_publishers (
        publisher_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        public_key_pem TEXT NOT NULL,
        trust_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(trust_state IN ('trusted', 'revoked')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_registry_sources (
        registry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        key_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        root_public_key_pem TEXT NOT NULL,
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(enabled IN (0, 1)),
        cached_payload_json TEXT,
        cached_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS installed_extensions (
        plugin_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        current_revision_id TEXT,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('disabled', 'active', 'degraded', 'quarantined')),
        permission_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        installed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_revisions (
        revision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        version TEXT NOT NULL,
        package_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
        package_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        publisher_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        publisher_public_key_pem TEXT NOT NULL,
        manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('staged', 'healthy', 'failed', 'superseded')),
        failure TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        activated_at TEXT,
        FOREIGN KEY(plugin_id) REFERENCES installed_extensions(plugin_id)
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS extension_revisions_plugin_created
        ON extension_revisions(plugin_id, created_at DESC);

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_grants (
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        permission_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        permission TEXT NOT NULL,
        scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        granted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        revoked_at TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY(plugin_id, permission_revision, permission)
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_install_previews (
        preview_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('install', 'update')),
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        registry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        package_url TEXT NOT NULL,
        package_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        publisher_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        publisher_public_key_pem TEXT NOT NULL,
        manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        requested_permissions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        committed_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_audit (
        audit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        plugin_id TEXT,
        revision_id TEXT,
        action TEXT NOT NULL,
        outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
        trace_id TEXT,
        detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS extension_audit_plugin_time
        ON extension_audit(plugin_id, occurred_at DESC);

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_documents (
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        collection_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        document_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(plugin_id, collection_name, document_id)
      );

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_document_index_values (
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        collection_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        index_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        text_value TEXT,
        number_value REAL,
        boolean_value INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY(plugin_id, collection_name, document_id, index_name),
        FOREIGN KEY(plugin_id, collection_name, document_id)
          REFERENCES extension_documents(plugin_id, collection_name, document_id)
          ON DELETE CASCADE
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS extension_document_index_text
        ON extension_document_index_values(plugin_id, collection_name, index_name, text_value);
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS extension_document_index_number
        ON extension_document_index_values(plugin_id, collection_name, index_name, number_value);

      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extension_event_checkpoints (
        plugin_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(plugin_id, subscription_id)
      );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        short_drama_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        target_audience TEXT,
        target_word_count INTEGER,
        target_episode_count INTEGER,
        core_hook TEXT,
        emotional_core TEXT,
        core_selling_point TEXT,
        synopsis TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        style_guide TEXT,
        visual_style_direction TEXT,
        genre_opportunity TEXT,
        production_brief TEXT,
        current_adaptation_id TEXT,
        deleted_at TEXT,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS projects_updated_at
        ON projects(deleted_at, updated_at DESC, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS series (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_series (
        project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        series_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        joined_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_series_series
        ON project_series(series_id, project_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS series_story_bible (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        series_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS series_story_bible_series
        ON series_story_bible(series_id, updated_at DESC);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS series_story_bible_overrides (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series_story_bible(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        source_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(project_id, source_id)
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS series_asset_links (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        series_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES series(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        source_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        target_project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        target_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('copy', 'fork', 'link')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(target_asset_id)
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS series_asset_links_target
        ON series_asset_links(target_project_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace_source_imports (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        preview_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace_import_extractions (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        source_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_title TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        candidates_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        adoptions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        applied_at TEXT,
        undone_at TEXT,
        error_message TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workspace_import_extractions_project
        ON workspace_import_extractions(project_id, updated_at DESC, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_tasks (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        parent_task_id TEXT REFERENCES automation_tasks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        payload_json TEXT,
        result_json TEXT,
        error TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS automation_tasks_created
        ON automation_tasks(created_at DESC, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_revision_previews (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        base_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        proposed_content TEXT NOT NULL,
        rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        committed_at TEXT
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_idempotency (
        scope TEXT NOT NULL,
        idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        status INTEGER NOT NULL,
        response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(scope, idempotency_key)
      );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_pilot_plans (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        chapter_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        chapter_versions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        episode_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        adaptation_id TEXT,
        episode_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        error_message TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS automation_pilot_plans_project
        ON automation_pilot_plans(project_id, updated_at DESC, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_change_previews (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        session_id TEXT,
        run_id TEXT,
        task_id TEXT,
        engine_kind TEXT,
        task_type TEXT,
        targets_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        committed_at TEXT
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_provider_action_previews (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        session_id TEXT,
        run_id TEXT,
        task_id TEXT,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        model_id TEXT,
        parameters_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        estimated_cost REAL,
        currency TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        executed_at TEXT
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_templates (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        body TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automation_template_runs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES automation_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        rendered TEXT NOT NULL,
        variables_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        missing_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO automation_templates(
        id, project_id, title, body, created_at, updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000301', NULL,
        '分集诊断摘要', '项目：{{project}}
分集：{{episode}}
目标：{{goal}}',
        '2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z', '2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z'
      );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chapters (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        order_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        outline TEXT,
        content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        main_conflict TEXT,
        hook TEXT,
        highlight TEXT,
        reversal TEXT,
        cliffhanger TEXT,
        short_drama_note TEXT,
        ai_video_note TEXT,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chapters_project_order
        ON chapters(project_id, order_index, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS writing_chapter_versions (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
        snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(chapter_id, version_number)
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS writing_chapter_versions_chapter
        ON writing_chapter_versions(chapter_id, version_number DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS writing_resources (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('characters', 'outlines', 'story-arcs')),
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        parent_id TEXT,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS writing_resources_project_kind
        ON writing_resources(project_id, kind, updated_at DESC, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS writing_idempotency (
        scope TEXT NOT NULL,
        idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(scope, idempotency_key)
      );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS writing_volumes (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        outline TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        order_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS writing_volumes_project_order
        ON writing_volumes(project_id, order_index, id);
      ALTER TABLE chapters ADD COLUMN volume_id TEXT
        REFERENCES writing_volumes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chapters_project_volume_order
        ON chapters(project_id, volume_id, order_index, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS writing_creator_content (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('profile', 'column', 'idea', 'draft', 'variant', 'calendar')),
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        parent_id TEXT,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft', 'researching', 'review_required', 'ready', 'scheduled', 'archived')),
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS writing_creator_content_project_kind_status
        ON writing_creator_content(project_id, kind, status, id);
CREATE TABLE writing_creation_adoptions (workflow_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_story_bible_settings (
        project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        auto_suggest INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_story_bible_change_sets (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        source_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        source_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        task_id TEXT,
        conflict_notes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        preview_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_memory_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        applied_at TEXT,
        undone_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_story_bible_project
        ON knowledge_story_bible_change_sets(project_id, updated_at DESC);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_story_bible_stale_marks (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        resolved_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(project_id, chapter_id, resolved_at)
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_chapter_memories (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_change_set_id TEXT REFERENCES knowledge_story_bible_change_sets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );

ALTER TABLE knowledge_chapter_memories
        ADD COLUMN version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_records (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN (
          'story', 'character-states', 'story-bible', 'story-events',
          'foreshadowings', 'memory', 'visual-profiles', 'visual-settings',
          'chapter-memories', 'story-bible-sidecar-preferences'
        )),
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        parent_id TEXT,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_records_project_kind
        ON knowledge_records(project_id, kind, updated_at DESC, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_research_topics (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        query TEXT NOT NULL,
        risk_domain TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(risk_domain IN ('general', 'finance', 'health', 'legal')),
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft', 'researching', 'ready', 'archived')),
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_research_topics_project_status
        ON knowledge_research_topics(project_id, status, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_research_sources (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        topic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_research_topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_type IN ('duckduckgo', 'gdelt', 'wikimedia', 'rss_atom', 'manual_url', 'local')),
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        url TEXT,
        excerpt TEXT,
        published_at TEXT,
        data_date TEXT,
        retrieved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('discovered', 'adopted', 'rejected')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(topic_id, url)
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_research_sources_topic_status
        ON knowledge_research_sources(topic_id, status, created_at DESC, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_research_findings (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        topic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_research_topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        statement TEXT NOT NULL,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('fact', 'quote', 'inference', 'creator_opinion')),
        source_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft', 'supported', 'stale', 'blocked')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_corpus_sources (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        url TEXT,
        domain TEXT,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        excerpt TEXT,
        content_hash TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('quarantined','allowed','blocked','takedown')),
        rights_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(rights_status IN ('unknown','review_required','allowed','restricted','removed')),
        locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh-CN',
        retrieved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_corpus_source_url
        ON knowledge_corpus_sources(url) WHERE url IS NOT NULL;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_corpus_items (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        source_id TEXT REFERENCES knowledge_corpus_sources(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(visibility IN ('public','private')),
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN (
          'meme','comic_device','dialogue_pattern','character_hook',
          'relationship_hook','conflict','reversal','scene','world_rule',
          'style','social_observation'
        )),
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        trigger_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        mechanism TEXT NOT NULL,
        emotional_effect TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        contexts_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        risk_tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        freshness TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(freshness IN ('emerging','stable','cooling','expired','evergreen')),
        rights_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(rights_status IN ('unknown','review_required','allowed','restricted','removed')),
        locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh-CN',
        tombstoned_at TEXT,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_corpus_visibility_freshness
        ON knowledge_corpus_items(visibility, freshness, updated_at DESC, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_corpus_collections (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        corpus_item_id TEXT REFERENCES knowledge_corpus_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        mechanism TEXT NOT NULL,
        notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        adopted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(adopted IN (0,1)),
        use_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_provenance_edges (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        from_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        from_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation IN (
          'collected_from','inspired_by','derived_from','generated_from','adopted_from','quoted_from'
        )),
        to_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        to_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        quote_excerpt TEXT,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(from_type, from_id, relation, to_type, to_id)
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_provenance_project
        ON knowledge_provenance_edges(project_id, created_at, id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_causal_nodes (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN (
          'character','event','secret','rule','location','organization',
          'resource','relationship','inspiration'
        )),
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        source_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(confirmed IN (0,1)),
        version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_causal_nodes_project
        ON knowledge_causal_nodes(project_id, kind, created_at, id);
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_causal_edges (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        from_node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_causal_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        to_node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_causal_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation IN ('causes','enables','blocks','reveals','conflicts_with','depends_on')),
        rationale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

      ALTER TABLE agent_evaluation_candidates
        RENAME TO agent_evaluation_candidates_four_engine;
      CREATE TEMP TABLE agent_evaluation_candidate_remap AS
      SELECT evaluation_id,
             candidate AS old_candidate,
             char(96 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY evaluation_id ORDER BY candidate
             )) AS candidate
      FROM agent_evaluation_candidates_four_engine
      WHERE engine_kind <> 'grok';
      CREATE TABLE agent_evaluation_candidates (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        evaluation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        candidate TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(candidate IN ('a', 'b', 'c')),
        engine_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(engine_kind IN ('pi', 'codex', 'langgraph')),
        run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        output_json TEXT,
        metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(evaluation_id, candidate),
        UNIQUE(evaluation_id, engine_kind)
      );
      INSERT INTO agent_evaluation_candidates(
        id, evaluation_id, candidate, engine_kind, run_id, status,
        output_json, metrics_json
      )
      SELECT source.id, source.evaluation_id, remap.candidate,
             source.engine_kind, source.run_id, source.status,
             source.output_json, source.metrics_json
      FROM agent_evaluation_candidates_four_engine source
      JOIN agent_evaluation_candidate_remap remap
        ON remap.evaluation_id = source.evaluation_id
       AND remap.old_candidate = source.candidate;

      ALTER TABLE agent_evaluation_reviews
        RENAME TO agent_evaluation_reviews_four_engine;
      CREATE TABLE agent_evaluation_reviews (
        evaluation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        preferred_candidate TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(preferred_candidate IN ('a', 'b', 'c', 'tie')),
        accepted INTEGER NOT NULL,
        notes TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      );
      INSERT INTO agent_evaluation_reviews(
        evaluation_id, preferred_candidate, accepted, notes, created_at
      )
      SELECT review.evaluation_id,
             CASE
               WHEN review.preferred_candidate = 'tie' THEN 'tie'
               ELSE remap.candidate
             END,
             review.accepted, review.notes, review.created_at
      FROM agent_evaluation_reviews_four_engine review
      LEFT JOIN agent_evaluation_candidate_remap remap
        ON remap.evaluation_id = review.evaluation_id
       AND remap.old_candidate = review.preferred_candidate
      WHERE review.preferred_candidate = 'tie' OR remap.candidate IS NOT NULL;

      UPDATE agent_evaluations
        SET status = 'ready_for_review', revealed_at = NULL,
            updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
        WHERE id IN (
          SELECT review.evaluation_id
          FROM agent_evaluation_reviews_four_engine review
          LEFT JOIN agent_evaluation_candidate_remap remap
            ON remap.evaluation_id = review.evaluation_id
           AND remap.old_candidate = review.preferred_candidate
          WHERE review.preferred_candidate <> 'tie' AND remap.candidate IS NULL
        );
      UPDATE agent_evaluations
        SET status = 'failed', revealed_at = NULL,
            updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
        WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')
           OR NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM agent_evaluation_candidates candidate
             WHERE candidate.evaluation_id = agent_evaluations.id
           );

      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO production_seasons(
        id, project_id, adaptation_id, title, outline, status, order_index,
        version, created_at, updated_at
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' ||
        lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' ||
        lower(hex(randomblob(6))),
        r.project_id,
        r.id,
        '第1季', '', 'ready', 0, 0, r.created_at, r.updated_at
      FROM production_records r
      WHERE r.kind = 'adaptations'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM production_records earlier
          WHERE earlier.project_id = r.project_id AND earlier.kind = 'adaptations'
            AND (earlier.order_index < r.order_index OR (earlier.order_index = r.order_index AND earlier.id < r.id))

        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM production_seasons s WHERE s.project_id = r.project_id

        plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','committed','expired')),
        etag TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        committed_at TEXT
      );

      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO screenplay_documents(
        id, script_record_id, project_id, title, source_format, blocks_json,
        loss_report_json, legacy_payload_json, version, created_at, updated_at
      )
      SELECT
        lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' ||
        '4' || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' ||
        substr('89ab', abs(random()) % 4 + 1, 1) ||
        substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(6))),
        record.id, record.project_id, record.title, 'native',
        json_array(json_object(
          'id', lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-' ||
            '4' || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' ||
            substr('89ab', abs(random()) % 4 + 1, 1) ||
            substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(6))),
          'type', 'action',
          'text', coalesce(
            json_extract(record.payload_json, '$.content'),
            json_extract(record.payload_json, '$.正文'),
            record.title
          )
        )),
        json_object(
          'unsupported', json_array('legacy_unstructured_payload'),
          'warnings', json_array('旧通用剧本记录已映射为单个 Action block；原 payload 保留只读备份。'),
          'preserved', json_array('legacy_payload_backup')
        ),
        record.payload_json, 0, record.created_at, record.updated_at
      FROM production_records record
      WHERE record.kind = 'scripts';

        CHECK(provider_kind IN ('seedance','minimax_h3_cloud'));
      ALTER TABLE media_video_jobs ADD COLUMN model_revision TEXT;
      ALTER TABLE media_video_jobs ADD COLUMN idempotency_key TEXT;
      ALTER TABLE media_video_jobs ADD COLUMN request_sha256 TEXT
        CHECK(request_sha256 IS NULL OR length(request_sha256) = 64);
      ALTER TABLE media_video_jobs ADD COLUMN remote_status TEXT NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 'queued'
        CHECK(remote_status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','canceled'));
      ALTER TABLE media_video_jobs ADD COLUMN archive_status TEXT NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 'not_started'
        CHECK(archive_status IN ('not_started','pending','archived','failed','unavailable'));
      UPDATE media_video_jobs
        SET remote_status = status,
            archive_status = CASE
              WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 'unavailable'
              ELSE 'not_started'
            END;

        ON media_video_jobs(provider_id, idempotency_key)
        WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL;
